statement: With the rho-family restart defect of examples/mt_fieldops.rs fixed (all 1584 v2 rho jobs rerun, every target verified), the cheapest of four rho arms is 1.4-4.8% cheaper and multi-target IC4 costs 0.951-0.991x it per target at T = 16384 on the v2 curves (cheaper at every I/M and h against this harness's rho family); against the same family with Kuhn-Struik retention IC4 is 1.12-1.17x at h = 0 at T = 16384 (1.12-1.48x over all six v2 cells) and the v2 decisions are 0 cheaper, 6 unranked, 12 dearer. IC4 vs paired BSGS is unchanged (1.18-1.80x).
